summary: 80-year-old Gerald (Gerry) Boland, retired Lyons math teacher and basketball coach, went missing after taking his wife to safety on Thursday and returning to their flood-damaged home in Lyons; two search teams went looking for him on Monday 2013-09-16
notes: Date approximate: last seen Thursday 2013-09-12 returning home; two search teams out Monday 2013-09-16; obituary confirms he died during the flood near his home; pending lead from run 63 resolved by obituary; September 2013 Front Range flood
